description: Land Acquisition - Ellakattuwa, Madyama, Nuwaragampalatha D/S Division, Anuradhapura District
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of a specific land parcel (0.0600 Hectare in Allakattuwa village) for public purposes.
